messages:
mira: Quick rollcall — Moonshot model intake. Catalog launch prep tomorrow AM. Need clear owners for: licensing signoff, perf profile final, infra sizing, and canary plan. Who's got the final OK? :eyes:
alyssa: I can own perf profile finalization. ran a quick sweep on staging: `p50 85ms / p95 310ms` with fp16+8-bit output. Need to confirm quant profile for dedicated.
devin: Infra note — dedicated pool currently has 2 nodes free in us-west. If we enable 8-bit runtime we can fit expected qps, otherwise we'll need an extra node. @mira can you confirm target qps?
mira: Target qps ~120 steady, bursts to 300. If 8-bit keeps perf close to fp16 then sounds fine.
raj: License check: Moonshot's upstream license is CC-BY-NC-SA (non-commercial sharealike). That's incompatible with our hosted catalog default. We either mark as 'private-only' for now or get an exception from legal. @mira, did intake capture dataset provenance?
mira: We have provenance notes in the intake form (link: https://redwood.internal/intake/345). I flagged it as 'needs-legal' already. Quick decision needed — do we postpone hosted or ship as dedicated/private?
tom: Product preference is to include in catalog as 'private/dedicated only' if legal requires it. We can still show perf tiles but hide hosted endpoint.
alyssa: Perf addendum: when I tested with kv-cache enabled, token throughput improved ~1.6x for typical 1-2 sentence prompts. Recommend enabling prefix cache by default for catalog entry.
devin: Action for infra: if we go dedicated/private-only, no extra infra changes needed aside from tagging pools. If we want hosted fallback we need legal clearance + +1 node for autoscale buffer.
raj: I can fast-track review if we get the provenance artifacts and the model card (license, training data summary). Send them to legal-queue with `LIC-MOONSHOT` in the subject.
mira: I'll attach artifacts in 15m. @alyssa, can you finalize the perf profile + quant recommendation by EOD?
alyssa: Yep — will post a short JSON snippet to this thread.
alyssa: ```json
{
  "profile": "moonshot-v1",
  "quant": "8-bit-static",
  "p50_ms": "85",
  "p95_ms": "310",
  "notes": "kv-cache on; recommended for short-chat workloads"
}
```
mira: Perfect. @devin can you pre-tag a dedicated pool 'moonshot-dedicated' so legal review doesn't block provisioning?
devin: Done. Created pool and pre-tagged, no nodes allocated yet. CLI: `infra pool create --name moonshot-dedicated --tags model=moonshot`
deploy-bot: Scheduled snapshot backup for intake artifacts at 2025-06-02T02:00:00Z.
raj: Received the intake artifacts. I'll review and aim to reply within 24 hours. If legal blocks hosted, we proceed with private/dedicated only per product.
mira: OK — owners summary: licensing -> raj, perf/profile -> alyssa, infra provisioning -> devin, product rollout config -> tom. I'll update the catalog launch checklist and ping ops. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alyssa: One small ask — can we gate canary to 5% and monitor token-level latency and hallucination metric? I'll add eval hooks.
tom: Sounds good. Add me to the canary alert channel.
mira: Closing loop: I'll post final checklist by EOD. If legal approves hosted, we flip a flag; if not, we ship in dedicated/private-only mode.
